relationships.subject: TRPV4
relationships.evidence_quote: we also found that TMJ inflammation-mediated upregulation of TRPV1 and TRPA1 mRNAs is dependent on TRPV4 because their increases are absent in TRPV4 KO mice

relationships.subject: TRPV4
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicate that TRPV4 is necessary for masticatory sensitization in TMJ-inflammation and likely functions up-stream of MEK/ERK phosphorylation in trigeminal ganglion sensory neurons in-vivo.

relationships.subject: botulinum toxin type A
relationships.evidence_quote: peripheral application of BoNT-A significantly lowered the increased expression of TRPA1, TRPV1 and TRPV2, but not TRPM8

relationships.subject: botulinum toxin type A
relationships.evidence_quote: It has been demonstrated that BoNT-A inhibits TRPV1 trafficking to the plasma membrane in TG neurons [63]

relationships.subject: ADM12
relationships.evidence_quote: ADM12 was able to abolish the increase of TRPA1, calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP), substance P (SP), and cytokines gene expression in the TG, cervical spinal cord, and medulla induced by IoN-CCI [41].

relationships.subject: IGF-1
relationships.evidence_quote: binds to TRPV2, which subsequently increases TRPV4 expression in TRPV2-positive small-medium sized TG neurons

relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Injection of capsaicin or mustard oil, the agonists of TRPV1 and TRPA1, respectively, into the masseter muscle produced nocifensive responses and subsequent mechanical hyperalgesia in rats [20].

key_findings: TRPV1, TRPA1, TRPV4, TRPM8 contribute to TMJD, trigeminal neuralgia and dental pain; TRPV4 is upstream of TRPV1/TRPA1 upregulation and MEK/ERK in TMJ inflammation.
BoNT-A reduces trigeminal neuropathic allodynia, associated with suppressed TRPA1/TRPV1/TRPV2 upregulation.
